Kaggle_T4_Single.suitability_assessment: Zero-cost baseline. 30 hours weekly recurring quota provides infinite long-term experimentation headroom. 16 GB VRAM allows batch 16.

Kaggle_T4x2_MultiGPU.interconnect: Standard PCI-e Bus (NO NVLink / virtualized hypervisor bus)
Kaggle_T4x2_MultiGPU.quota_consumption: Standard Kaggle policy deducts 1 GPU-hour per session wall-clock hour (or 2x if accounting strictly by device)
Kaggle_T4x2_MultiGPU.distributed_protocol: PyTorch DistributedDataParallel (DDP) via torchrun with NCCL backend
critical_caveats: 2 GPUs != 2x performance. PCIe gradient synchronization overhead will reduce scaling efficiency.
4 host vCPUs must feed 2 GPUs simultaneously (2 workers per GPU max before CPU thrashing).
